title: 瑞银Adrian：AI热潮遇信贷压力，还能追吗？
speaker: Adrian Zuercher

segments.en: We can see it fits very well into the AI cycle. Europe struggles a bit more.
segments.zh: 我们看到它非常契合AI周期。欧洲则稍显吃力。

segments.en: But we also can start to see that there's some tolls now on credit spreads overall.
segments.zh: 但我们也开始看到，整体信贷利差出现了一些代价。

segments.en: I mean, U.S. high yield spreads are that widest for the year.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，美国高收益利差达到年内最阔水平。

segments.en: And it's probably also related on some of the funding that it's needed to basically finance the whole AI investments.
segments.zh: 这可能也与为整个AI**提供资金所需的部分融资有关。

segments.en: And so, we start to see that there's some cracks coming up and or question marks on how sustainable it is, how long it can go.
segments.zh: 因此，我们开始看到一些裂痕出现，或者对其可持续性、能持续多久存在问号。

segments.en: But overall, we still remain very positive on the topic.
segments.zh: 但总体而言，我们仍对该主题非常乐观。

segments.en: And therefore, I think there's more upside.
segments.zh: 因此，我认为还有更多上行空间。
